paragraphs.text: The Aysen crusaders are the home militia of Aysen on the plane of Ulgrotha .

Comprised mostly of commoners and volunteers, they are best known for the wise commanders that lead them to victories against evil creatures and the treacherous minions of Baron Sengir . It takes a strong leader or Hero to make a rabble armed with hoes and spears into a fighting force good enough to defeat the occasional creature that rampages through the countryside.
